question: The VA National Formulary lists semaglutide one way. My pt is on NY Medicaid. Is Ozempic covered for them?
assumption: Assuming NY Medicaid (NYRx PDL), type 2 diabetes use; the VA formulary doesn't apply.
answer:
Assuming NY Medicaid (NYRx PDL), T2DM use: yes, the pen is covered.

| Product | PDL status |
|---|---|
| Ozempic pen | Preferred (no PA/ST flags on the row) |
| Ozempic tablets | Non-preferred (PA required) |

- The class has Clinical Criteria (CC): confirm an FDA-approved or compendia-supported, Medicaid-covered indication.
- PA is required if the patient is using a GLP-1 and a DPP-IV inhibitor concurrently.
- No effective-date markers appear on these rows, so I found no pending change as of 10/17/2026.
- The VA formulary status is irrelevant to NYRx.
